title: tinystoragedrivers queue manifest
description: Queues declared for a QueueStore. Loaded by tinystoragedrivers_core::queue::QueueManifest, which rejects unknown fields and duplicate names.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, for editors. Not interpreted.

queues.description: The declared queues. Each name appears at most once.

name.description: Queue name: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

owner.description: The component that consumes the queue.

max_attempts.description: Deliveries a message gets before it is dead-lettered. A lapsed lease counts.

dedupe_window_ms.description: How long an acknowledged dedupe key keeps rejecting re-enqueues, in milliseconds. 0 forgets it at acknowledgement.

visibility_ms.description: Lease length consumers should request when they receive, in milliseconds.
